docs.purpose: The wall a refused lot lookup shows on the phone (task-452 SEARCHFIX.4; RR-0443, RR-0444 2b, RR-0466). At the monthly report limit the person sees one neutral notice: "You’ve used all {limit} reports" as its emphasised first line, "Your count resets on {date}." smaller beneath it, then "Lot reports you’ve opened this month stay available.", "Your Tracked Lots remain." and "Your plan is managed on the web for changes.", and a Go to Tracked Lots button. With an expired subscription the notice is the reactivate sentence and the same plan line, with the same button. No top-up or upgrade control until the buying work (RR-0454 item 3). Drawn in place of the search page, and on the report screen under its Back bar while no report is shown.
docs.data_story: It reads one contract, GET /api/parcels/entitlement (contract_parcels_entitlement), through useParcelEntitlement (the query key the search page already reads, so no extra request). The count is reportsLimit and the date is the server label resetsOnDisplay (RR-0310); the 403 body of the lookup carries its own limit and ISO date, kept on ReportLimitError and never drawn. Which wall shows is searchWall (mobile/src/lib/parcelSearchMatch.ts) over the lookup error class and that read. It emits **no analytics event**.
docs.under_126: **CONVERTED (SEARCHFIX.4)** — LIST, drawn from the rows of screens.mobile_parcel_wall in scripts/surfaces/_schema/static-page.json by pageProps (PageTableBinding.tsx) through WallBinding.tsx and the shared SurfaceRenderer.tsx, the second screens row after the semi page (task-357 ruling, MD:1476). It owns no component and has no route of its own: two mounts (the search page and the report route) draw it through useWallState.ts.

tables: src/lib/entitlements/index.ts — readParcelToolUsage (the entitlements row of product parcel_tool)

identity.owner: unassigned (no CODEOWNERS file and no owner registry exists in the repo — measured 2026-09-16)

versioning.why: It reads the entitlement read as parsed by ParcelToolEntitlementSchema (a plain object, additive_only); a field it needs that is null draws no wall (today’s notice stays).

inputs.why: One GET /api/parcels/entitlement through useParcelEntitlement, the same TanStack entry the search page reads; plus the lookup error class its host passes in (ReportLimitError or SubscriptionRequiredError from mobile/src/lib/apiClient.ts).

outputs.why: It writes nothing. The only action is Go to Tracked Lots, a tab switch (router.navigate to PARCEL_TAB_ROUTE.tracked); it records no recent search.

state.why: No store and no field of its own: it reads the existing entitlement query and the lookup error its host already holds.

staleness.why: useParcelEntitlement declares staleTime ENTITLEMENT_STALE_MS (the search slice config entitlement_stale_ms, 0) and is re-read on focus of the search page.

session.why: It shows only after the lookup route refused: the 403 is the gate (a display, never a gate on the phone); the tab gate and the parcel-tool Stack are inherited.

rls_class.why: entitlements is read as the table owner through the entitlement route; no client read.

guards.rate_bucket: none — the wall makes no request of its own; the entitlement read is the search page’s

checks.why: RR-0310: the count and the date are the entitlement read’s served values; the 403’s own values are never drawn and a failed read keeps today’s notice. Locked by mobile/__tests__/parcelSearchMatch.test.ts (searchWall) and parcelSearchScreen.behaviour.test.tsx.

RR-0444 2b: the reactivate state shows only for an expired subscription; no plan (task-357), an active status and a failed read keep today’s notice. Locked by mobile/__tests__/parcelSearchMatch.test.ts.

errors.why: The wall is itself the declared failure UI of two refusals: the report limit (rate_limited) and an expired subscription (unauthorized). Every other failure keeps the host’s own notice.

classes.ui: REPORT_LIMIT_REACHED: the limit notice with the read’s count and date, the two lead lines, the plan line and Go to Tracked Lots. SUBSCRIPTION_REQUIRED with status expired: the reactivate sentence, the plan line and Go to Tracked Lots.

emits.why: No client analytics; the wall emits nothing.

metering.why: The wall counts nothing; the lookup route counts a produced report and sends the limit 403 (F02).

config.why: No tunable: the wall reads no setting of its own.

sharing.why: It shares contract_parcels_entitlement and its query with the search page (S-002).

deviations.from: Spec 126 §11a.1 closed binding set: a client derivation picks the state
deviations.why: searchWall (mobile/src/lib/parcelSearchMatch.ts) maps the lookup error class and the entitlement read to the flags limit and reactivate (the closed list WALL_FLAG_NAMES); task-357 extends this row by a dated note with no_plan.
deviations.adjudicated_by: task-452 plan grounder (v1 mobile-99-p1#5 CONFIRMED; RR-0444 2b, RR-0455, RR-0466)

limitations.what: A failed entitlement read keeps today’s notice even at the limit: the count and date are drawn only from the read.
limitations.measured: mobile/src/lib/parcelSearchMatch.ts searchWall returns null on isError.

limitations.what: No top-up or upgrade control and no way to sign up: both wait for the buying work (RR-0454 items 3 and 4); the no-plan page is task-357.
limitations.measured: mobile/src/components/surfaces/WallBinding.tsx WALL_FLAG_NAMES holds limit and reactivate only.

notes: SEARCHFIX.4 (task-452). One layout, two states, phone first; the web keeps its one not-entitled notice until its switch-on (RR-0455 item 1).

programme.why: The refusal screens of the parcel tool entry flow (objective G.6).
